P3A-A-EVAL-NU-ODD_CUBE_SUM-01:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=0.
NUMBER cube=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { cube=i*i*i. IF (i%2!=0) { total+=cube. } }
DISPLAYNL(total-1).
P3A-A-EVAL-NU-DESCENDING_PRODUCT-01:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER product=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<n, i++) { product*=i+1. }
DISPLAYNL(product-n).
P3A-A-EVAL-AR-NEGATIVE_SQUARE-01:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER total=1.
NUMBER current=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { current=values[i]. IF (current<0) { total+=current*current. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).
